text:
incident-bot: [P1] eu-west embeddings: elevated KV-cache evictions and 503 spike (INC-4392). Auto-page sent to oncall. Affected routes: /v1/embeddings, /v1/search. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction :rotating_light:

maya (oncall): seeing ~4/12 nodes with eviction churn, p95 token latency ↑. Canary rollout looks rolled back automatically. Starting quick triage.

lucas: I'm in shadow-standby for the shift; happy to assist on infra-level changes.

maya (oncall): assigning primary/secondary — I will own mitigation now, sam you are secondary until 08:00 UTC. Sam?

sam: ack. will take over primary at 08:00 UTC unless we resolve earlier.

irene: customer impact: two enterprise workflows retried and timed out; CS looped in, ticket created: CS-7821. No mass outage reported but visible error rate for embeddings ~3.5%.

maya (oncall): quick actions executed:
```
# scale embeddings pool to absorb burst
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/embeddings-pool --replicas=14
# bump cache hysteresis timeout (temporary)
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/embeddings-pool CACHE_HYSTERESIS=120
```

sam: added +2 nodes in the autoscale group, verified endpoints returned to healthy. Rolling throttle reduction on long tail requests. Observability: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv/evictions?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west

maya (oncall): monitoring notes — watch eviction_rate, node memory pressure, and redis hit ratio. If eviction_rate > 5% for 10m, run compaction script and escalate to eng-infra.

lucas: quick log snippet from failing pod:
```
2026-03-17T07:12:03Z embeddings-5f6d9 ERROR evicting key user:abc:kv cache full
2026-03-17T07:12:04Z embeddings-5f6d9 WARN oom-killer invoked, restarted process
```

maya (oncall): current status — mitigations applied, customer impact reduced to intermittent errors, autoscale stable. Next steps: monitor 30m, follow up with infra on compaction toggle, CS will update impacted customers.

opsbot: Reminder — next handoff scheduled at 08:00 UTC. Current primary: maya (oncall) -> sam at handoff. Secondary: lucas (shadow).

sam: I'll run a health-check script at 07:55 UTC and confirm handoff readiness. Planning to leave notes in the incident ticket and add links to the small-runbook patch I used.

maya (oncall): leaving these short runbook pointers in INC-4392: compaction playbook, autoscale tuning, and canary rollback checklist. Action owners: maya (mitigation), sam (handoff), lucas (infra follow-up), irene (CS comms).

maya (oncall): tagging for postmortem candidate — low impact but operational cadence and autoscale thresholds need review. :memo:

sam: acked. will close thread after handoff if stable. :thumbsup:
